items.claim: Tai Miller has good boxing combinations, high volume, and high work rate.
items.quote: his boxing combinations are good. He throws a high volume, high work rate.

items.claim: Tai Miller possesses underrated power, good speed, and good timing.
items.quote: He has underrated power-wise. His speed and timing is very good as well.

items.claim: Tai Miller maintains good composure and has a good chin and durability despite fighting in the pocket.
items.quote: he's got a good chin, good durability.

items.claim: Tai Miller has proven he can go the full three-round distance, having gone to decision multiple times.
items.quote: He's already been tested in my opinion as well. You know, he's gone to decision multiple times. We know he can fight the full three round distance.

items.claim: Tai Miller is untested in the grappling department.
items.quote: He's been untested in the grappling.

items.claim: Billy Ray Gooff applies constant pace and pressure to his opponents.
items.quote: He always puts the pace and pressure on his opponent.

items.claim: Billy Ray Gooff has more UFC experience and has fought a higher level of competition than Tai Miller.
items.quote: Billy is a little bit more proven as in like he's had way more UFC fights... and he's fought better level of competition.
